optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Client Onboarding Specialist, Private Banking KYC
professionalSummary: Seasoned onboarding specialist with three years of experience managing approximately ninety private banking onboarding files annually, ensuring compliance with identity and source‑of‑wealth verification standards. Proven track record in preparing onboarding files for compliance review, maintaining accurate trackers for relationship managers, and delivering comprehensive weekly status reports to senior leadership.
experienceHighlights: Collected and verified identity and source‑of‑wealth documents for ~90 private banking onboarding files per year against the bank’s onboarding checklist, recording each verification step in the onboarding tool.
Prepared each onboarding file for the compliance reviewer, recorded the reviewer’s decision and attached conditions, and published outcomes to relationship managers.
Maintained the onboarding tracker for eleven relationship managers, proactively chasing missing documents and escalating overdue files to the head of onboarding.
Prepared the weekly onboarding status report for the head of onboarding, detailing files by stage, missing documents, and conditions.
Managed end‑to‑end onboarding responsibilities—including document verification, file preparation, decision recording, tracker maintenance, and weekly reporting—for three years.
projectsAndWorkSamples: An anonymised onboarding file record (checklist, verification log, reviewer decision and conditions) and a weekly status report, accompanied by the onboarding tool’s audit history as a verification trail.
optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The provided resume and work sample confirm the candidate’s experience and responsibilities in private banking onboarding, including document verification, file preparation, tracker maintenance, and reporting. No evidence is provided regarding the candidate’s age or any potential age discrimination concerns beyond a recruiter note.

role.roleTitle: Client Onboarding Specialist, Private Banking KYC

evidence.text: Collected and verified identity and source-of-wealth documents for about ninety private banking onboarding files a year against the bank's onboarding checklist, recording each verification step in the onboarding tool.

Work sample: an anonymised onboarding file record (checklist, verification log, reviewer decision and conditions) and one weekly status report, with the onboarding tool's audit history as a verification trail.

Prepared each onboarding file for the compliance reviewer and recorded the reviewer's decision and the attached conditions in the file record; the approval decision was the reviewer's, and I published the outcome to the relationship manager.
Kept the onboarding tracker current for eleven relationship managers, chasing missing documents with the clients' assistants and escalating files older than thirty days to the head of onboarding.
Prepared the weekly onboarding status report for the head of onboarding, listing files by stage, files with missing documents and files with conditions.
Responsibilities covered document verification, file preparation, decision recording, tracker maintenance and weekly reporting on the onboarding desk for about three years.
